sn22.7:3.2: But that feeling of theirs decays and perishes,
sn22.7:3.3: and consciousness latches on to the perishing of feeling.
sn22.7:3.4: Anxieties occupy their mind, born of latching on to the perishing of feeling, and originating in accordance with natural principles.
sn22.7:3.5: So they become frightened, worried, concerned, and anxious because of grasping.
sn22.7:4.3: But those choices of theirs decay and perish,
sn22.7:4.4: and consciousness latches on to the perishing of choices.
sn22.7:4.5: Anxieties occupy their mind, born of latching on to the perishing of choices, and originating in accordance with natural principles.
sn22.7:4.6: So they become frightened, worried, concerned, and anxious because of grasping.
sn22.7:7.2: When that feeling of theirs decays and perishes,
sn22.7:7.3: consciousness doesn’t latch on to the perishing of feeling.
sn22.7:7.4: Anxieties—born of latching on to the perishing of feeling and originating in accordance with natural principles—don’t occupy their mind.
sn22.7:7.5: So they don’t become frightened, worried, concerned, or anxious because of grasping.
